title: Comment templates
name: Name
variableHelp: Wrap variable names in double braces. Field names match the API; record dates use ISO format. Date variables use your local time.
tooLong: The resulting comment exceeds 2,000 characters. Shorten it before inserting.
append: Text is appended to the current comment. You can edit it before saving the action.

errors.conflict: This template changed. Reload it before saving.
errors.nameTaken: A template already uses this name.

validation.name: Enter a name of up to 120 characters.
validation.body: Enter text of up to 2,000 characters.
validation.archived: Choose whether this template is archived.

referenceIntro: Wrap a field path in double braces. Select a category or search for a field, then click a variable to insert it. In action comments, clicking inserts the current value; in templates, it inserts the variable.
referencePaths: Use dots for nested fields. Arrays start at 0: plant.measurements.0.value is the first measurement; .length gives the item count. Dynamic cycle stages and custom actions use their own IDs.
referenceHistory: action describes the action you are entering, before it is saved. plant.events contains saved actions, newest first (0 is the latest). Each event includes its date, comment, stage changes, snapshot and accessible attachments. History and photo lists load only when the selected template references them.
referenceValues: Empty fields become empty text; zero and false stay explicit. A missing path or an unavailable record blocks insertion. Preview values refresh when action choices change, but already inserted text is not changed automatically.
referenceDates: date.today and date.now use the configured date format and local time; date.iso is UTC. Stored dates and action.occurredAt use ISO 8601. A blank action date means now. Durations are days, harvest weight is grams, theoretical yield is g/m²; measurement units are in .unit.
referenceSafety: Only information accessible to your account is available. Variables do not run code or expressions. Comments are limited to 2,000 characters.
exampleNotice: The reference combines API-shaped examples and values loaded for this plant. Examples are illustrative and are never substituted for missing real data.
contextFailed: Some information could not be loaded. Use Reload details to retry; unavailable variables cannot be inserted.
